posts.zh:
dsh-tool-generate-image 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6cbc05c890e46b43dc20.html
posts.en:
dsh-tool-generate-image is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6cbc05c890e46b43dc20.html
